description: An electric guitar held up to a screaming amplifier: six comb-filter strings, a short air delay and a saturating amp stage wired into one loop that takes off and howls

params.text: Sets how much of the amp's output goes back round the loop, 0% to 200%; below about 100% a fed note dies away, above it the loop howls on its own
Sets how far the guitar stands from the amp as a delay in the loop, 5ms to 100ms, which settles which harmonics win
Sets how long the strings ring, as the feedback of their comb filters; high settings favour harmonic screaming
Sets the corner of the amp's low-pass, 400Hz at the bottom of its travel to 10000Hz at the top; darker settings turn the shriek into a moan
Sets how hard the amp stage saturates, which is also the loop's limiter, so more of it means more compression and grit
Bends every string down, by up to one octave at the top of its travel
Attenuates the signal at the in jack before it is fed to the strings, 0% to 100%

inputs.text: Added to the gain knob, a fifth of its travel per volt
Retunes the six strings; unpatched they are a guitar's E2, A2, D3, G3, B3 and E4, and a polyphonic chord here gives them its notes, repeating an octave up where the chord has fewer than six
Added to the whammy knob, a tenth of its travel per volt
A signal fed into the strings through the in lvl knob: a guitar, a drum loop, anything
Added to the dist knob, a tenth of its travel per volt, so ten volts sweeps the whole distance
Added to the decay knob, a tenth of its travel per volt; gated low it palm-mutes the feedback and high it lets it ring
Added to the tone knob, a tenth of its travel per volt

outputs.text: The amp's output, bounded by the amp stage at roughly ±5V

notes: with nothing patched, turn gain past the middle and give it a moment: a faint internal noise floor seeds the loop and it starts howling by itself.
the pitch it settles on comes from the string tuning, the amp distance and the tone control fighting each other, not from any one of them.
the lamp beside the output follows its level.
